inputs.name: NativePickerSwitchService.constructor.rpc
inputs.description: RPC callback used for thread reads, remote-control checks, unsubscribe, loaded-chat polling, resume, and verification. It receives a method and PickerData params, may receive options, and resolves to PickerData.

inputs.name: NativePickerSwitchService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Configures the client-close timeout and the catalog path used for Claude resumes. Without timeoutMs, waitClosed uses 10,000 ms; catalogPath is assigned to model_catalog_json only for harness-claude.

inputs.name: NativePickerSwitchService.apply.params
inputs.description: Supplies the thread ID, selected model, and optional reasoning effort for the switch. threadId must be a string; claude-opus-5-5 selects harness-claude, while other strings not starting with claude- select openai.

inputs.name: NativePickerSwitchService.apply.context
inputs.description: Supplies extra fields for thread/resume and defaults to {} when omitted. Its fields are spread into the resume target, while threadId, cwd, model, modelProvider, and config are set by the switch.

outputs.name: NativePickerSwitchService.apply
outputs.description: Resolves to the PickerData returned by thread/resume after the resumed thread matches the selected model, provider, and reasoning effort. The resolved record is returned without further normalization.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error is thrown for a missing or non-string threadId, an unsupported model, a non-idle chat, ephemeral history, enabled remote control, incomplete client closure, or mismatched resumed settings. Resume or verification failures trigger rollback; if rollback cannot be verified, apply rejects with a manual-recovery Error.
